day_titles.6: Saigon and the Cu Chi tunnels

Check in and meet the rest of the group
Rest of the day free at your own pace

2: Breakfast, then a guided day of the city
The mausoleum and the one pillar pagoda
The Temple of Literature, the old university
The old quarter lanes in the afternoon
3: Breakfast and check out, then the flight to Da Nang

Rest of the day free at your own pace

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Three cities in a week with a group, two nights in each, and nothing on the itinerary you will wish you had skipped.
expert.tip: Da Nang is the one to use for an early swim. My Khe beach is twenty minutes on foot and calm before eight.

summary: A week in three cities with a small group: two nights in Hanoi with a guided city day, two in Da Nang with a full day at Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, then two in Saigon with the city and the Cu Chi tunnels.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; two domestic flights; all coach travel and transfers; a guided Hanoi city tour; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge; a half day Saigon city tour with the Cu Chi tunnels.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
